name: 大卷压花家庭装卷纸款
description: 冷调深蓝信息图套图，图标卖点、撕口与叠层双栏对照、规格阶梯与整箱到货收口

styleLock.direction: clean premium paper-goods commerce on a cool high-key studio system
styleLock.backgroundSystem: one seamless cool studio cyclorama #F2F5F9 for packshots, one deep field #14357C meeting a sky tabletop #6EC6F2 for infographic screens, and three graduated pale panels #E8EDF3 / #C9DCEE / #9FBEDC for pain-point and hand-feel screens; no other background is allowed
styleLock.lightingSystem: broad even high-key key from the front-left at 5000-5600K with a large fill card opposite, soft-to-medium contact shadow directly under every object, low skimming side light only inside macro screens, no hard speculars and no colored gels
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte laminated paper-goods surface, loose sheets with real embossed relief, and one kraft corrugated carton interior #B4884F as the only prop surface; no marble, no wood grain, no textile drape
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family, headline above a hairline divider, at most three short labels per screen, no serif, no script, no cartoon lettering
styleLock.iconSystem: flat hairline pictograms inside empty circular plates in #FFFFFF on the deep field, uniform stroke weight, at most one #E0357E accent per screen
styleLock.presentationRules: carry-pack always upright with a real contact shadow and nothing cropped, loose rolls standing on a flat base with the core opening visible, identical camera distance and light on both panels of any comparison, one consistent 3/4 reading angle for the pack across the whole set
noDrift: no brand name, wordmark, slogan or character mascot graphic
no roll-count, sheet-count, pack-count or yardage numerals
no softer-than, absorbs-X-times or one-roll-equals-N-rolls comparison claims
no certification marks, forest or quality seals, URLs or store badges
no recognizable face or identifiable model styling
no invented lab data, ratings or testimonials
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean premium paper-goods ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep ink field #14357C, sky tabletop #6EC6F2, snow body surface #FFFFFF and one magenta accent #E0357E over graduated cool panels #F2F5F9 / #E8EDF3 / #C9DCEE / #9FBEDC; cool high-key studio lighting, broad front-left key with large fill, soft honest contact shadows, skimming side light only in macro screens; one modern geometric sans-serif family with headline over hairline dividers; flat hairline pictograms inside empty circular plates, single accent only; matte paper-goods surfaces plus one kraft corrugated carton interior; stable upright pack placement and identical scale across paired panels; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清提装轮廓与卷层排布，抢住点击。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, carry-pack upright and centered, full pack visible
shots.lighting: broad even high-key front-left key with large fill, soft contact shadow under the pack
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce product hero. Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: win the search click with one clean compliant packshot. Composition: the carry-pack stands upright and centered, photographed straight-on at eye level, full pack visible with nothing cropped, roll tops reading as one level row across the pack mouth, the pack occupying 60-70% of the frame. Lighting: broad even high-key key from the front-left with a large fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow directly beneath the pack, no specular blowout. Colors: cyclorama #F2F5F9, text #22303F, one accent #E0357E held back for later screens. Style: truthful commercial packshot, real print-on-film packaging and real paper edges, vertical edges kept vertical. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: no extra whitespace, the pack owns the centre. In-image text: none. Negative: no props, no hands, no people, no character mascot, no watermark, no fake logo, no QR code, no badge stickers, no price or promo wording, no roll-count or sheet-count numerals, no comparison wording, no floating pack, no cut-off edges, no gradient background, no duplicated roll rows.

shots.intent: 一秒给出核心主张，用三个空白图标位承接后续卖点。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle showing the full pack facade, pack at frame left
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with even fill, restrained rim along the loose roll edge, honest contact shadows
shots.background: deep field #14357C grading to sky tabletop #6EC6F2
shots.props: one unwrapped roll standing at the pack front-right, three empty circular icon plates stacked down the right column
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 45% for copy
shots.textZone: 右侧 45% 三枚空白图标位，各配一行短标「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic benefit screen. {product} with one loose roll standing beside the pack. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: land one core promise at a glance for a shopper who will not read. Composition: the pack sits at frame left at a slight 3/4 angle showing its full facade, one unwrapped roll stands at its front right on the same surface, and a vertical stack of three empty circular icon plates runs down the right 45% of the frame; pack and roll together occupy 50-60% of the frame. Lighting: soft front-left key with even fill, restrained rim along the roll edge, honest contact shadows on the tabletop. Colors: deep field #14357C, sky tabletop #6EC6F2, icon plates and text #FFFFFF, one accent #E0357E. Style: clean premium paper-goods commerce, thin flat pictograms only, no photo collage. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: generous negative space on the right 45% reserved for copy. In-image text: three short labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 beside the empty icon plates, no other wording. Negative: no percentages or multiples, no softer-than or equals-N-rolls claims, no competitor marks, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no QR code, no character mascot, no hands, no floating rolls, no cut-off pack edges.

shots.intent: 把撕不干净、纸页软垂的日常烦躁摆到眼前，制造替换动机。
shots.camera: photographed from a very low angle near holder level looking slightly upward
shots.lighting: harder flatter top light at 6000K with a dimmer surround so the failure reads heavy, short shadow behind the sheet
shots.background: graduated pale panel #C9DCEE wall with a brushed metal wall holder
shots.props: one plain wall holder, one hanging sheet with an untidy ragged torn edge, pack softly out of focus at the lower frame edge
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen. Still life of {product} with one sheet drawn from it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: agitate the everyday annoyance of a sheet that shreds and hangs limply after tearing. Composition: a plain wall-mounted roll holder is photographed from a very low angle near holder level looking slightly upward, one sheet hangs from it with an untidy ragged torn edge and one twisted lower corner, the carry-pack sits softly out of focus at the lower frame edge, sheet and roll occupying 40-50% of the frame. Lighting: harder flatter top light at 6000K with a slightly dim surround, short shadow pooling behind the hanging sheet. Colors: wall panel #C9DCEE, brushed metal hardware, text #22303F. Style: unvarnished documentary still life, no dramatized effects, no litter flying. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: no extra whitespace, the hanging sheet carries the frame. In-image text: none. Negative: no brand marks on holder or sheet, no competitor reference, no character mascot, no torn fragments floating in mid-air, no hands, no faces, no watermark, no fake logo, no spec numbers, no fabricated tear diagram, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 用双手环抱的真实手感交代厚实度，让买家把自己代入。
shots.camera: straight-on at chest height with a very slight 3/4 turn of the shoulders, head cropped out of frame
shots.lighting: soft diffused front key at 5000K with wrap-around fill, faint hand shadow across the roll
shots.background: plain chambray shirt as the backdrop panel #9FBEDC
shots.props: one unwrapped roll held with both hands, one drawn sheet showing a clean wavy tear line
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce lifestyle scene. {product} cradled in two hands at chest height. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: communicate cushioned hand-feel and let the buyer picture it in their own home. Composition: a person cropped from the neck down in a plain chambray shirt holds one unwrapped roll with both hands at chest level, photographed straight-on at chest height with a very slight 3/4 turn of the shoulders, one sheet drawn over the roll edge showing a clean wavy tear line, the roll occupying 40-50% of the frame. Lighting: soft diffused front key at 5000K with gentle wrap-around fill, faint shadow of the hands falling on the roll, no hard speculars. Colors: shirt backdrop #9FBEDC, sheet surface reading as #FFFFFF, text #22303F. Style: candid domestic realism with visible skin texture and real paper fibers. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: no extra whitespace, the arms frame the roll. In-image text: none. Negative: no visible face, no identifiable model, no deformed or extra fingers, no painted nails as a focal point, no jewellery catching light, no plastic-looking paper, no watermark, no fake logo, no character mascot, no text overlay, no floating roll without hand contact, no cut-off product edges.

shots.intent: 同机位双栏呈现两种撕口结果，不靠任何主张也说清差别。
shots.camera: dead-on flat frontal wall view, identical distance and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: one soft frontal key, identical intensity and direction on both panels, gentle shading behind each sheet
shots.background: deep field #14357C with a hairline vertical divider
shots.props: two identical wall holders at the same height, one sheet hanging in each panel
shots.whitespace: clean negative space across the top 22% for copy
shots.textZone: 顶部 22% 留白供一行主张「{selling_point_1}」，两栏内不出现品牌或标签
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen, two matched panels separated by a hairline vertical divider with identical camera distance and framing on both sides. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Subject: {product} read through two wall-mounted holders. Purpose: let the two tear outcomes speak side by side with no numbers. Composition: photographed dead-on in a flat frontal wall view; the left panel shows a sheet hanging with an untidy ragged lower edge, the right panel shows a sheet hanging with a clean decorative wavy edge, both holders at the same height with the same spacing, the paper content occupying 50-60% of the frame overall. Lighting: one soft frontal key at identical intensity and direction across both panels, gentle contact shading behind each sheet. Colors: backdrop #14357C, divider and paper #FFFFFF. Style: neutral clinical demonstration, nothing embellished. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: clean negative space across the top 22% for copy. In-image text: one short line 「{selling_point_1}」 in the top margin, both panels otherwise free of wording. Negative: no competitor marks or lookalike packaging, no tick and cross graphics over a real brand, no fabricated lab data, no percentages, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no character mascot, no hands, no differing light between panels, no cut-off sheets.

shots.intent: 微距交代压花凸起与纤维厚度，用放大镜代替任何参数。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, lens skimming just above the sheet surface at a shallow side angle
shots.lighting: low skimming side light from the right with weak bounce on the left so each ridge casts a micro-shadow
shots.background: neutral matte board #EDF1F6 falling out of focus
shots.props: one pulled sheet, roll body reduced to a soft blur at the near frame edge
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail macro. Extreme close-up macro of one sheet pulled from {product}, tight zoom on the embossed relief and the torn top edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: prove body, embossing and fibre quality by magnification alone. Composition: the lens skims just above the sheet surface at a shallow side angle, the embossed pattern running diagonally out of frame, the roll body reduced to a soft blur at the near edge, shallow depth of field with the nearest ridges sharp, the detail filling 55-60% of the frame. Lighting: low skimming side light from the right with a weak bounce on the left so every embossed ridge casts a micro-shadow, no blown highlights. Colors: sheet surface #FFFFFF, backdrop board #EDF1F6, one accent tick #E0357E. Style: documentary macro with true fibre texture and no waxy coating. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: minimal whitespace, the texture is the subject. In-image text: none. Negative: no blurry subject, no glossy laminated look, no fabric or non-woven weave, no towel pile, no mould or dust specks, no watermark, no fake logo, no embossed lettering or brand pattern, no readable letters inside the relief, no hands, no extra props.

shots.intent: 用两叠纸页的真实高度差讲清厚实与回弹，替代任何数据主张。
shots.camera: photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile at table level, both panels matched
shots.lighting: soft even frontal key at 5500K with slight top fill, identical on both panels
shots.background: sky tabletop #6EC6F2 under a deep field #14357C
shots.props: two folded stacks of sheets, one hand resting flat on the taller stack, hairline divider between panels
shots.whitespace: clean negative space across the top 25% plus one empty label plate under each panel
shots.textZone: 顶部 25% 留白供「{selling_point_2}」，两栏底部空白标签位各供「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen, two matched panels on one table separated by a hairline vertical divider with identical camera and light on both sides. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Subject: two folded stacks of sheets cut from {product}. Purpose: show cushion and recovery as a plain height difference without a single number. Composition: photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile at table level; a short tidy stack stands in the left panel, a visibly taller layered stack stands in the right panel with one hand resting flat on its top sheet, both stacks casting real contact shadows, the two stacks together occupying 50-60% of the frame. Lighting: soft even frontal key at 5500K with slight top fill, identical on both panels. Colors: tabletop #6EC6F2, upper field #14357C, paper and text #FFFFFF. Style: honest demonstration still life, straight edges kept straight, no motion blur. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: clean negative space across the top 25% for copy plus one empty label plate beneath each panel. In-image text: headline 「{selling_point_2}」 in the top margin and two short labels 「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」 inside the blank plates under each panel. Negative: no fabricated test results, no invented benchmark, no brand marks on either stack, no competitor packaging, no numerals or percentages, no deformed fingers, no floating stacks, no mismatched shadows between panels, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 把可选卷径摆在同一尺度里，替买家完成选款并降低退货。
shots.camera: photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down the diagonal row of rolls
shots.lighting: soft top-left key with gentle falloff toward the farthest roll, elliptical contact shadows under each base
shots.props: three unwrapped rolls of visibly different diameter, one column of three empty rounded label plates at the right edge
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 30% for the label column
shots.textZone: 右侧 30% 三个空白圆角标签位，各供一行「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant screen. {product} shown as a size ladder. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: let the shopper choose between roll sizes inside one honest frame. Composition: three unwrapped rolls of visibly different diameter and height stand in a diagonal row receding from the lower right to the upper left, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down so every core opening reads clearly, the largest roll nearest the camera, a column of three empty rounded label plates sitting along the right edge, the rolls occupying 60-70% of the frame overall. Lighting: soft top-left key with gentle falloff toward the farthest roll, true elliptical contact shadows under each base. Colors: field #14357C, paper and label plates #FFFFFF, nearest plate edge #E0357E. Style: clean catalogue rendering with correct relative scale and no exaggerated perspective. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: generous negative space on the right 30% for the label column. In-image text: three short labels 「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」 inside the empty label plates and nothing else. Negative: no size numerals or multiples, no invented dimensions, no duplicated rolls, no warped ellipse cores, no floating rolls, no watermark, no fake logo, no character mascot, no hands, no gradient background.

shots.intent: 提前告知同款可能到手的两种包装外观，避免收货落差与差评。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, two pack silhouettes at equal scale with a hairline gap
shots.lighting: flat even high-key frontal light, soft shadows directly under each pack, no rim drama
shots.props: two carry-pack silhouettes of different shape, two blank label plates beneath them
shots.whitespace: clean negative space across the top 22% and beneath both packs
shots.textZone: 顶部 22% 留白供一行说明「{callout_9}」，两包下方标签位保持空白
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen. {product} shown as two pack designs standing side by side. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: set delivery expectations so a different carton face never reads as a wrong shipment. Composition: two carry-pack silhouettes of different shape stand on one shallow shelf, photographed straight-on at eye level with equal spacing and equal scale, a hairline gap between them and blank plate space beneath each, the pair occupying 35-40% of the frame. Lighting: flat even high-key frontal light, soft shadows directly under each pack, no rim highlights. Colors: panel #E8EDF3, shelf #F2F5F9, text #22303F, accent #14357C. Style: calm informational screen with no decorative clutter, both silhouettes equally sharp. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: clean negative space across the top 22% and beneath both packs. In-image text: one short line 「{callout_9}」 in the top margin, both label plates under the packs left empty. Negative: no new-versus-old wording, no limited-time or stock wording, no price, no watermark, no fake logo, no QR code, no certification seals, no character mascot, no hands, no floating packs, no mismatched scale between the two packs, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 展示外箱开启后的整批到货状态，消除运输与囤货顾虑并收束全页。
shots.camera: photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down into the open carton mouth
shots.lighting: broad even key from the upper left at 5600K with soft bounce off the carton walls, honest contact shadows
shots.background: seamless studio floor #F2F5F9 with the corrugated interior reading as kraft #B4884F
shots.props: one opened corrugated carton with flaps spread, three carry-packs stepped in front of it
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, a clear floor margin keeps the group off the frame edges
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust closing screen. {product} arriving as a full shipping carton. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: remove last-mile risk and close the page by showing how the order actually lands. Composition: an opened corrugated carton stands behind with its flaps spread, three carry-packs are arranged in a stepped row in front of it, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down into the carton mouth so the empty interior reads clearly, the group occupying 50-60% of the frame. Lighting: broad even key from the upper left at 5600K with soft bounce from the carton walls, honest contact shadows under every pack, no glossy board sheen. Colors: floor #F2F5F9, corrugated board #B4884F, text #22303F. Style: truthful unboxing photography with real creases and real packaging. Aspect ratio 1:1, 2K. Whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond a clean floor margin that keeps the group off the frame edges. In-image text: none. Negative: no brand name or character mascot printed on the carton, no slogan, no shipping label with an address, no QR code, no warehouse clutter, no crushed or damp cardboard, no duplicated pack counts, no floating packs without contact shadows, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands.

provenance.notes: 11 张源片逐图事实：001 提装正面棚拍主图（角标为数量换算条）；002 同款两种包装外观并列告知；003 提装加一枚散卷、右栏三枚圆底图标配主张；004 颈部以上裁切的人物双手环抱散卷，衬衫充作背景；005 一枚大卷与一组小卷以等号并列；006 吉祥物头像居中、两侧各一幅撕开的纸页；007 双栏竖分隔线、两叠纸页、一只手按压较高一叠；008 三档卷径斜向阶梯配右栏标签；009 双壁挂纸轴并列，左页撕口毛糙、右页齐整波浪边；010 林丘插画加环形印章框与两处资质角标；011 瓦楞外箱开启、三提产品排在箱前。品类判定：图内为卷筒卫生纸多提装日常纸品，判为家居日用·纸品清洁（与源类目提示一致，非护肤个护、非母婴）。近重复合并：006 的吉祥物肖像无可复用信息，其撕纹纸页并入 006 位的压纹微距镜；005 的等号换算与 008 的规格阶梯合并为一枚规格阶梯镜；002 归入包装告知镜，011 归入整箱到货镜，合并后 10 镜。已剥离内容：品牌字标与系列名、蓝色吉祥物图形与全部角色形象、数量换算与「几倍柔」「几倍吸收」类对比主张、资质标志与网址文字、图内英文原句（改为「{callout_n}」「{selling_point_n}」占位）、对比双栏仅保留分栏与分隔线结构且不指向任何真实竞品。
